content:
Nora: Morning — kicking off Tidal onboarding tomorrow. Main goals: get them to an end-to-end demo, confirm success metrics, and identify renewal risks early. Who's in from Tidal? @Ethan please confirm SRE/PM attendees. :wave:

Ethan: Tidal will send PM + 2 devs + infra lead. I'll confirm emails in the invite.

Jia: I can run enablement and the training lab. Planning a 30-min demo + 30-min hands-on. Will capture recording and a 1-pager.

Marco: I'll own infra checks (API keys, rate limits, VPC rules). Need their staging jumpbox + test key by EOD tomorrow. Note: if they opt for Private deployment, timeline +7-10d. Tagging RISK-PRIVATE.

Nora: Proposed compact ramp:
```
Day 0: kickoff + SSO check
Day 1: API integration + smoke tests
Day 2-3: perf tuning + batching
Day 4-5: enablement + feedback
Day 6: retro + exec readout
```
Blockers by EOD please. :spiral_calendar:

Jia: Success criteria suggestion: integration green, 3 demo flows pass, median latency <300ms on 512-token sample, and post-training feedback >=80% positive.

Marco: SSO is biggest single risk — if cert exchange delayed >4d telemetry/analytics are impacted. Marking RISK-SSO. Also need test traffic profile from Tidal.

Ethan: Confirmed: Tidal infra lead is kevin@tidal.io, will share jumpbox by EOD. PM is lucy@tidal.io.

onboard-bot: Checklist created: https://redwood.checklists/2967002468 — owners assigned, meeting links, risk tags.

Nora: Owners: Jia = enablement & feedback, Marco = infra & perf, Ethan = customer liaison & invites, Nora = exec sync & escalation.

Jia: I'll publish the enablement deck tonight: https://go.redwood/tidal-enable and a short feedback form after sessions.

Marco: I'll try to get staging access by EOD; if blocked I'll flag immediately with RISK tag.

Nora: Thanks. Daily 10-min stand at 09:20 PST during the sprint. If anyone sees a critical risk call it out here and we'll escalate. :thumbsup:
